summary: Frontend-only regression for RND sample form focus-loss bug (labdip/handfeel/proofing). Tested continuous per-character typing (page.keyboard.type, delay=60ms) on ALL sample-spec-* and sample-*-input fields across (a) main create modal from ?view=rnd-samples, (b) galleries ?view=rnd-labdip|rnd-handfeel|rnd-proofing, and (c) switching between chip sample-type-labdip|handfeel|proofing. Verified for every field that (1) input_value equals the exact typed string, and (2) document.activeElement.data-testid remained the same input — proving focus is NOT lost per keystroke. Bug is FIXED. 20/21 field checks fully pass; the one non-focus discrepancy is that sample-spec-sku uppercases input ('ktn-150' -> 'KTN-150') which is an intentional transform (focus preserved, only value casing differs) — reporting as design note, not a focus bug.

issues: Input auto-uppercases while user types ('ktn-150' becomes 'KTN-150'). Focus is preserved (not the reported bug), but casing differs from what user types. Confirm this is desired UX; if yes, consider setting CSS text-transform for consistency with typed value shown.

critical_code_review_comments: SampleSpecFields L and FinalPanel Row moved to module-level scope — correct fix pattern to avoid remounting inputs each render. Continue applying this pattern for any other in-render sub-components in RND forms.
sample-spec-sku uppercasing changes user-typed value — surface visually via CSS text-transform: uppercase or explain via helper text to avoid confusion.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for focus-loss regression (21/21 fields kept focus); 20/21 value-exact (SKU uppercased by design)

seed_data_creation: None. Did NOT click sample-form-save; only typed to verify focus retention.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focus-loss bug on RND Labdip/Proofing/Handfeel forms is verified FIXED across all entry points (rnd-samples create button + rnd-labdip/handfeel/proofing gallery-create buttons + chip switching between sample-type-labdip|handfeel|proofing). Fields covered: sample-spec-gramasi, -lebar, -sku, -price, -notes, -yarn, -epi, -ppi, -composition, -finishing, -handfeel-target, sample-title-input, sample-qty-input, sample-brief-input. Only remaining note: sample-spec-sku uppercases input.
rca of the issue: Root cause (per main agent's fix): sub-components L (in SampleSpecFields.jsx) and Row (in design/FinalPanel.jsx) were defined inside the parent render function. Each keystroke caused parent re-render, which produced a new component reference, causing React to unmount/remount the input on every character — losing focus. Fix: moved L and Row to module scope so their component identity is stable across renders. Verified: after fix, activeElement stays on the input and full strings are typed continuously without focus loss.
